subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Learning club 1 – Lesson 1: Language booster (months, seasons, telling the time)
outcomes: Name the 12 months and the four seasons in order.
Tell the time with o'clock, quarter past, half past and quarter to.
Understand time differences and seasons in different countries.

tf.s: The Earth takes about 365 days to go around the Sun.
June, July and August are summer months in Europe.
Australia and Europe have opposite seasons.
tf.why: Yes, when one has summer, the other has winter.

tf.s: It is the same time everywhere in the world.
There are four seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter.
tf.why: Yes, those are the four seasons.

tf.s: New York is ahead of Muscat in time.
tf.why: New York is behind Muscat, by 8 hours here.

boxes.q: Which month is the first month of the year?
What season is it for Shihab in Oman in the dialogue?
How many hours are in one day?
boxes.why: The Earth turns once in about 24 hours.

boxes.q: Which is the last month of the year?

mcq.q: Which list shows the four seasons in order, starting with spring?
mcq.why: That is the order of the seasons.

mcq.q: Which months are winter in Europe?
mcq.why: Europe's winter is December to February.

mcq.q: Why do we have day and night?
o: The Earth turns, so one side faces the Sun.
The Sun goes around the Moon.
The Moon covers the Sun every evening.
The Earth stops moving at night.
mcq.why: The side facing the Sun has day.

mcq.q: It's 1:45. How do you say it?
New York is 8 hours behind Muscat. It's 3 p.m. in Muscat. What time is it in New York?
Which month is between April and June?
If it's summer in Oman, which season is it in Australia?
mcq.why: Australia's seasons are opposite to ours.

mcq.q: Your friend in New Zealand is in winter in July. What can you say?
o: It's hot in Oman, but it's cold in New Zealand.
The seasons are the same everywhere.
mcq.why: The two countries have opposite seasons.

mcq.q: Why is it a bad idea to call a friend in New York at 7 a.m. Muscat time?
o: It's 11 p.m. in New York, so they may be asleep.
It's lunch time in New York.
mcq.why: 7 a.m. minus 8 hours is 11 p.m. the night before.
